description: A TypeScript module providing a typed fetch wrapper with runtime validation using Zod, including functions for API requests, mutations, and integration with TanStack Query, along with token management.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for API request errors, including status code and response body.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token used in API requests.

methods.name: fetchJSON
methods.description: Performs a fetch request, validates response with Zod schema, and handles errors.

methods.name: mutateJSON
methods.description: Performs a mutation request (POST, PATCH, DELETE), validates response.

methods.name: createQueryFn
methods.description: Creates a TanStack Query-compatible query function.

methods.name: createMutationFn
methods.description: Creates a TanStack Query-compatible mutation function.
